notes.title: Minor update
notes.notes:
Level selector unlock page message more visible now
 Small audiovisual clue when you make a connected block chain in puzzle mode
 Fixed a bug in level 11 and level 13 where a block could be made to float in the air!

notes.title: Update 30/4/2022
notes.notes:
Level selector shows now completed levels without getting a medal with a checkbox tick
 You can progress to next page now if you solve 5 levels on previous page even without getting a medal
 You can select now previous  placed segments on infinite mode
 Infinite mode is tagged as beta. There might be some gameplay changes soon
 fixed a bug  where  and  were visible  after  pressing esc on victory
 Have fun!

notes.title: save progress hotfix
notes.notes: hotfix for people who may not be able to save progress

notes.title: Subcube Huge Update
notes.notes:
Subcube got renovated and it's a new game now

[previewyoutube=a9hcWfueHr0;full][/previewyoutube]



Major Changes:
[olist]
 New engine under the hood thanks to Godot Project. Now the game offers better graphics, and is far more maintainable
 Aesthetics: Video speaks for itself. 
 Smoother difficulty curve, and no more move limits. We don't want frustrated players. 
 Guaranteed intelligence increase (OK we may be exaggerating here, but sometimes you will feel a spark in your mind when you find a solution to a puzzle). 

[/olist]

notes.title: Another minor update
notes.notes:
Small fixes and tweaks

 R key resets level
 Z,X keys rotate views
 Relaxed conditions to unlock more levels
 Fixed shadow rendering issue


Next update hopefully will include the editor.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
Minor updates for subcube
[olist]
Fixed reset button bug
Now you can finish levels with more than 3*minimum moves and less than 4*minimum moves, though you won't be awarded a medal.
 finished levels are visible through different color at puzzle menu.

Have fun!
[/olist]
